children: TransMedics appointed Fernando Araujo as Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, effective September 21, 2026, with Gerardo Hernandez transitioning to an advisory role through April 30, 2027.
Outgoing Chief Financial Officer; non-executive employee then senior advisor
September 21, 2026 (non-executive employee until Dec 31, 2026; non-employee senior advisor until Apr 30, 2027)

Age 46; CFO GE HealthCare Advanced Imaging Solutions (2023–2026); SVP Finance 3M Enterprise Operations (Oct 2022–Mar 2023); prior GE finance roles; BBA Centro Universitario UNA; MBA Columbia Business School.
Served as Company CFO since 2024; will receive severance benefits per existing retention agreement; salary $535,000 while non-executive employee; equity awards continue to vest.
